thread:
marie: NovaEdge pinged us with a per-minute 'pulse' ingestion request. They want their minute deltas folded into our hourly entitlement billing but allow fuzzy mapping for small gaps.

diego: list of high-level choices: acceptance window for late minutes, dedupe rule, how to treat explicit zeros vs missing, and backfill policy. also: who owns disputes if we interpolate?

harpreet: technical constraints: we need idempotency across batches and sequence numbers if available. recommend canonical event: device_id | ts_utc | units | batch_id | seq. idempotency key = batch_id + device_id.

trey: will NovaEdge stream or batch? they said both. we must support out-of-order arrivals and up-to-2h lateness for partners with intermittent connectivity.

marie: sample they sent:
```
{
  "edge": "nova-411",
  "tz": "Europe/Berlin",
  "batch": "nv-20250605-09",
  "minutes": [
    {"t":"2025-06-05T08:12:00+02:00","v":7},
    {"t":"2025-06-05T08:13:00+02:00","v":0},
    {"t":"2025-06-05T08:20:00+02:00","v":4}
  ]
}
```

harpreet: mapping proposal: convert minute timestamps to UTC immediately, assign to UTC hour bucket, persist raw minute-level events for 7 days in raw lake for replay. create hourly rollups in the billing table once per hour + correction jobs for late minutes within a 2h window.

diego: billing classification idea (different thresholds than usual):
- >=50 minutes present => bill exact sum (full)
- 30-49 minutes => partial: estimate missing via exponential moving average per device for last 24h, cap adjustment to 10%
- 10-29 minutes => mark suspicious: bill conservative estimate (min(sum*0.85, ema)) and auto-open partner reconciliation ticket
- <10 minutes => treat as telemetry noise; credit back and flag for manual review

marie: partner asked if we can do 'fill-forward' for gaps <=4 minutes using last-observed per-minute rate. they accept an upstream tolerance of 3% on totals.

harpreet: implementation notes:
- store per-minute raw with partitioning by date/device to allow cheap replays
- dedupe using batch_id + seq or minute-ts fallback
- provide a partner-override flag to tighten/loosen thresholds per partner contract
- ensure DST handled by converting to UTC; document semantics clearly

trey: test plan: unit tests for dedupe + idempotency, integration replay harness for late batches, end-to-end e2e with NovaEdge sample data including clock skew scenarios. add chaos test for duplicates and reorders.

diego: financial impact: estimate 0.02% storage increase for 7d raw retention for current NovaEdge volume. finance needs a short note before we enable default minute retention.

billing-bot: Created ticket PART-6121: "NovaEdge minute-to-hour rollup + interpolation policy" assigned to marie, harpreet, diego, trey. ETA 2025-06-12

harpreet: action items:
- harpreet: PR for ingest schema, raw retention and idempotency (due Fri)
- trey: replay harness + chaos tests (due next Tue)
- diego: finalize billing thresholds doc + partner overrides (due Thu)
- marie: confirm NovaEdge acceptance tests and request larger sample backfill (due Thu)

marie: minor decisions we made in-thread: use UTC bucketing only, 2h late-arrival correction window, keep minute raw for 7d, EMA for partial-hour estimates, fill-forward gaps <=4m, partner-override flag.

trey: linking draft PR https://git.redwood.internal/p/r/integrations/nova-pulse if you want to peek.

diego: I'll draft the reconciliation notes for disputes and include example SQL to recompute hours from minutes for audit.

marie: scheduling a 30m call with NovaEdge + eng tomorrow 9:30am CET. tagging @harpreet @diego @trey :calendar: 

harpreet: will add DST and clock-drift examples to the runbook.

marie: closing thread pending the sync. will post acceptance checklist after the call. :white_check_mark:
